licence.ffmpeg: FFmpeg is free software under the LGPL 2.1 or later. This build has no GPL parts. It runs as a separate program and you can replace it.
licence.espeak: eSpeak NG pronunciation data is free software under the GPL 3 or later. It is a separate download used only to read text aloud, and the app does not change it. The matching source code is published with each release at https://github.com/kirykr/FlickFluent/releases.
licence.runtimePack: The engine pack runs as a separate program and you can replace it. It contains free software under other terms: eSpeak NG (GPL 3 or later, inside sherpa-onnx) and the LAME MP3 encoder wrapper lameenc (LGPL 3), which the music separator loads but this app never uses. The matching source code is published with each release at https://github.com/kirykr/FlickFluent/releases.
licence.nllb: NLLB-200 translation is licensed CC BY-NC 4.0 by Meta. It is free only for non-commercial use. Do not use the translations in a product you sell or for paid work. Turn it on only if that suits you; the default translator has no such limit.
licence.piperVoice: This voice was trained on a public speech recording. Its licence allows use in a product; some voices ask you to credit the speaker.
licence.nonCommercial: This model is free only for non-commercial use. Do not use what it makes in a product you sell or for paid work.
